meta.source: Solace App Screens and Solace Admin Portal design canvases, 16 Oct 2026

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Mobile screen background and admin page background. Cards sit on it in `surface-card`.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, the bottom nav and the admin sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Summary rows inside cards, neutral pills, table row dividers.

tokens.name: surface-track
tokens.usage: Track behind a segmented control; the selected segment is `surface-card`.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Loading placeholder bars and blocks. Never used for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on `surface-page`, `surface-card` and `surface-sunken` (15.4:1 on page).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary body text, sidebar items, unselected admin tabs; offline banner fill (white text on it 12.2:1).

tokens.name: ink-neutral
tokens.usage: Text on neutral pills (`surface-sunken`), 8.4:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta text, labels, table headers, unselected nav items. 6.4:1 on `surface-page`, 6.1:1 on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, the dashed 'add' control text, drag handles. 5.0:1 on white, 4.6:1 on `surface-page`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand`, `brand-deep`, `danger` and `brand-splash` fills (8.0:1 on brand).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and section borders, nav top border. Decorative only (1.3:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed outlines of disabled slots and empty placeholders. Decorative only; never the border of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, secondary buttons, chips and option cards; switch track when off; empty stars and radio rings. 3.5:1 on white, 3.3:1 on `surface-page`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected states, links, active nav, progress, switch on. Text on white 8.0:1.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed primary; text on `brand-tint` and `brand-tint-strong` (9.9:1 and 8.7:1).

tokens.name: brand-night
tokens.usage: Call screen background and pills on it; `on-brand-night` text on it.

tokens.name: brand-call-control
tokens.usage: Round call controls (mute, camera) on `brand-night`. White icon 7.4:1.

tokens.name: brand-offline
tokens.usage: In-call status notice fill; `brand-tint` text on it.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected chip and option fills, active sidebar item, success-neutral pills.

tokens.name: brand-tint-strong
tokens.usage: Initials avatar fill, stronger selected tint.

tokens.name: brand-line-on-dark
tokens.usage: Border of outline buttons placed on a `brand` fill (2.1:1; the label carries the meaning).

tokens.name: on-brand-night
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `brand-night` (9.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-splash
tokens.usage: Splash screen ground only, behind the splash logo.

tokens.name: brand-splash-ring
tokens.usage: The two decorative discs on the splash screen.

tokens.name: on-splash-muted
tokens.usage: Language line at the foot of the splash (5.3:1 on `brand-splash`).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm sand. Upcoming-session icon tiles, highlight blocks, the border of a soft warning notice. Never a text colour.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` (7.7:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, crisis entry points, error text. White on it 9.1:1; on `danger-tint` 7.8:1.

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Outline destructive buttons (cancel booking, delete account) on white, 7.4:1.

tokens.name: danger-count
tokens.usage: Crisis count badge in the admin sidebar, white numerals.

tokens.name: danger-call-end
tokens.usage: The round 'End session' button on call screens, white icon 5.3:1.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Danger notice and pill fills.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of quiet destructive buttons in admin (reject, suspend).

tokens.name: danger-line-soft
tokens.usage: Border of crisis and safety-plan cards on mobile.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Unread dots, pending marks, count badges with white numerals (4.7:1).

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-tint` (8.5:1).

tokens.name: warning-ink-deep
tokens.usage: Body text inside warning notices on `warning-tint`.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning notice and pill fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Small confirmations with a check icon. 4.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: track-pink
tokens.usage: Cycle tracking (PCOS & cycle module): period markers, selected flow border, chart bars. Icons only on `track-pink-tint` (3.5:1).

tokens.name: track-pink-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `track-pink-tint` and `track-pink-soft` (10.2:1).

tokens.name: track-pink-tint
tokens.usage: Cycle tracking chip and card fills.

tokens.name: track-pink-soft
tokens.usage: Cycle tracking icon discs and pink initials avatar.

tokens.name: track-blue
tokens.usage: Daily check-in module: icons and selected borders. 5.1:1 on white, 4.3:1 on `track-blue-tint`.

tokens.name: track-blue-tint
tokens.usage: Daily check-in tiles and selected fills.

tokens.name: track-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative disc on daily check-in cards.

tokens.name: track-lavender
tokens.usage: Second series in Trends charts (sleep). Decorative bars only.

tokens.name: track-gold
tokens.usage: Decorative disc on module catalogue cards.

tokens.name: rating-star
tokens.usage: Filled stars on session ratings. 3.3:1 on white; empty stars use `line-control`.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Talk to someone who gets it
styles.usage: Onboarding and splash-adjacent headlines, one per screen.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Mobile screen titles; admin page titles.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Mobile home greeting and section-led screens.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Sheet titles, booking summary, admin record names.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card headings that lead a block.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Brand name in the admin sidebar (20px there), small card titles.

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Labels of mobile primary and danger buttons.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Mobile secondary buttons and form field values.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your specialist sees your notes only if you share them.
styles.usage: Mobile body text and list rows. Use weight 600 for row titles.

styles.name: body-admin
styles.usage: Admin body text and table cells; mobile notices.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Admin buttons and sidebar items (500 when not selected).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, helper text and secondary lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its meta line; sidebar item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Progress step gap, segmented control inset, icon-to-label in nav.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Chip rows, pill icon gap, admin tab gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in buttons; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Rows inside cards; notice icon gap; admin list gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Default stack gap on mobile; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Option card padding; table cell horizontal padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Large card padding; admin panel padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Mobile screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Space between sections; bottom inset under the nav.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Admin page top padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Admin page side gutter.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Progress steps and chart bar tops.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Small inline tags and keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: App icon in notification previews; small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-9
tokens.usage: Admin tab buttons inside a 12px tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Admin compact buttons, sidebar items, segmented segments.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Admin buttons and inputs; mobile icon tiles and small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-14
tokens.usage: Mobile secondary buttons, inputs, option cards, notices, segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: Mobile primary buttons; cards.

tokens.name: radius-18
tokens.usage: Large cards (home, crisis, safety plan).

tokens.name: radius-28
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, chat input, count badges.

size.note: Control heights and frames, copied from the screens.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: back button, icon buttons, list rows.

tokens.name: size-button-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile primary button height (56px on onboarding).

tokens.name: size-field-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile inputs, selects and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Toggle chips on mobile (36px in dense rows).

tokens.name: size-control-admin
tokens.usage: Admin buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: size-tab-admin
tokens.usage: Admin tab buttons.

tokens.name: size-badge
tokens.usage: Count badges.

tokens.name: size-phone-width
tokens.usage: Design width of every mobile screen.

tokens.name: size-admin-sidebar
tokens.usage: Admin sidebar width at desktop sizes.

shadow.note: Solace separates surfaces with borders, not shadows. The one shadow is the focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px white gap, then a 2px `brand` ring (7.4:1 on `surface-page`). Added for handoff; the screens do not draw focus.
